key: A country appears with 4 themes (population, area, GDP…). Pick the theme where that country ranks best — closest to No. 1 — and keep your run going as long as you can.
fr: Un pays s’affiche avec 4 thèmes (population, superficie, PIB…). Choisissez le thème où ce pays est le mieux classé — le plus proche de la 1ʳᵉ place — et enchaînez le plus longtemps possible.
en: A country appears with 4 themes (population, area, GDP…). Pick the theme where that country ranks best — closest to No. 1 — and keep your run going as long as you can.

key: A country is shown: find its capital among four choices.
fr: Un pays s’affiche : retrouvez sa capitale parmi quatre propositions.
en: A country is shown: find its capital among four choices.

key: A country leaves the list after two correct answers in a row. These runs earn coins but stay off the leaderboard.
fr: Un pays sort de la liste après deux bonnes réponses d’affilée. Ces parties rapportent des pièces mais restent hors classement.
en: A country leaves the list after two correct answers in a row. These runs earn coins but stay off the leaderboard.

key: A country name appears. Spin the 3D globe and tap the right country to find it.
fr: Un nom de pays s’affiche. Faites tourner le globe 3D et tapez sur le bon pays pour le localiser.
en: A country name appears. Spin the 3D globe and tap the right country to find it.

key: A country’s outline appears with no name and no neighbours. Pick a difficulty each question — DUO (2 options), CARRÉ (4 options) or CASH (type it) — to score more.
fr: La forme d’un pays s’affiche, sans nom ni frontières voisines. Choisissez votre difficulté à chaque question — DUO (2 choix), CARRÉ (4 choix) ou CASH (à écrire) — pour marquer plus de points.
en: A country’s outline appears with no name and no neighbours. Pick a difficulty each question — DUO (2 options), CARRÉ (4 options) or CASH (type it) — to score more.

key: A flag is shown: guess which country it belongs to, from the options.
fr: Un drapeau s’affiche : devinez à quel pays il appartient, parmi les propositions.
en: A flag is shown: guess which country it belongs to, from the options.

key: A good run of answers pushes your total up.
fr: Une bonne série de réponses fait grimper votre total.
en: A good run of answers pushes your total up.

key: A live duel: you and your opponent answer the same questions (capitals, flags…), each on your side. The higher score wins the round.
fr: Un duel en ligne : vous et votre adversaire répondez aux mêmes questions (capitales, drapeaux…), chacun de votre côté. Le meilleur score remporte la manche.
en: A live duel: you and your opponent answer the same questions (capitals, flags…), each on your side. The higher score wins the round.

key: A mystery country is hidden. With each try you name a country and the game shows how it compares to the target: right continent, distance and direction, population, area… Identify it in as few guesses as possible.
fr: Un pays mystère est caché. À chaque essai, vous proposez un pays et le jeu vous montre ce qui le rapproche de la cible : bon continent, distance et direction, population, superficie… Identifiez-le en le moins d’essais possible.
en: A mystery country is hidden. With each try you name a country and the game shows how it compares to the target: right continent, distance and direction, population, area… Identify it in as few guesses as possible.

key: A non-neighbouring country costs a life (3 lives per route): think it through — you can’t undo a step.
fr: Un pays non voisin coûte une vie (3 vies par trajet) : réfléchissez bien, on ne peut pas revenir en arrière.
en: A non-neighbouring country costs a life (3 lives per route): think it through — you can’t undo a step.

key: A player seems to have left the match.
fr: Un joueur semble avoir quitté la partie.
en: A player seems to have left the match.

key: A point is dropped on a 3D globe with no borders at all: say which country it lies in. Pick a difficulty each question — DUO (2 options), CARRÉ (4 options) or CASH (type it) — to score more.

en: A point is dropped on a 3D globe with no borders at all: say which country it lies in. Pick a difficulty each question — DUO (2 options), CARRÉ (4 options) or CASH (type it) — to score more.

key: A point on a borderless globe: which country?
